title: Cooking Class
summary: We will be having the first cooking class for the season on Tuesday, June 9th in the South Clubhouse kitchen starting at 10am and lasting approximately 3 hours. You will be making Rice Pudding, and the Chef is Tom Sagitas. Anyone interested please contact me no later than Monday, June 8th to sign up. We will only allow 10 people to participate, so contact me as soon as possible!
